[spoiler=[b]Astanir civil war RP[/b]]
[u][b]In the Ostland region; Nordiheim[/b][/u]
The training of the Kuhaw Argossians in Nordiheim was close to compleation with them learning quickly to make use of and integrating the Aborian and Ostlandian training they were reciving, only training in the use of specialized vehicles, boats and weapons remained together with special training in their squads ability to opperate independantly so that they wouldn't be paralyzed by being cut off from HQ.
Nordiheim would also prepare weapons, vehicles and equipment for them when they were ready, including some special boats for amphibious actions, that was being gathered up in ostland and quality checked.
They would be sendt  to the Kuhaw-astan on the main island of Astanir to join their brethren in whatever they might be planing to do in future plans and tactics together with some boats such as older tactical boats and 5 Ratatoskr-Class Patrol boats.

There would also be desided to send a few destroyers to Kuhaw-astan of the older Skoell-class (Spruance-class more or less) wich would help to beef up their navy, there was only 2 left of them in the reserve fleet wich were also the last ones to be taken out of active service back in 2005, with the rest of them either being sold, scrapped or striped of anyting of use for use as future target practice, but these two was in both good condition and able to fire cruise missiles wich would enable the Argossians to fire at the restorationists or isolationists from the sea to soften their lines.
Though they would need a quick trip in the drydocks for some inspections and minor fixing to make sure they actualy would opperate as intended.
They would be ready to sail at around the same time as the training of the Argossians in Nordiheim was finished if everyting went as planed.

[u][b]Supporting the Kuhaw-astan in their next endevor[/b][/u]
On the mainland of Astanir the situation of the restorationists and the isolationists was quickly turning bad and then worse, with the UDF attacking the stronghold island and cutting the mainland forces of the restorationists off from the support that they relied on from it and the "Democratic" front backed by the Qianxun pushing the isolationists hard with multible forces the new plans of the Kuhaw-astan would be relayed to the Nordiheimian.

Nordiheim would continue to supply them with the weapons, vehicles and munitions that they needed with some extra reserve tanks and drones to replenish any losses that they substained, but would also provide them with someting new-ish.
A bunch of man sized and cheap drones, with explosives integrated into them, would be given to the Kuhaw-astan, these were drones that the Nordiheimian military were not entierly sure if it was worth investing into at this time.
 But the battlefield of the Astanir civil war could be a good place to see them in action, it was hoped that having them basicly tested in a live conflict would provide them with information they could use to either reject them or start propper production and use of them.

Another ting that Nordiheim would provide the Argossians with was more tactical and battlefield information on the restorationists to the north of the Kuhaw-astan main area, using both air survailance and additional infiltrators and spies being deployed into the area.
They would relay the numbers, equipment and placement of important logistics sites that the restorationists most likely were dependant on to keep their lines supplied and opperational such as HQs, munitions depots and fire support sites.

Hoppefully this support would enable the Argossians to make their next attacks with high effect and minimal losses to their forces.
[/spoiler]
[/quote]

[b]Ostlandic Training[/b]
The situation on the mainland was getting better day by day. Now, with the newly trained soldiers integrated into the ranks of the Kuhaw-Astan army, they would be ready for a huge attack on the mainland.

The ships provided to Kuhaw-Astan would be integrated into the navy, which was currently serving patrol purposes only. Kuhaw-Astan knew that they couldnt yet retake the lower islands, so they would focus on the mainland for now.

[b]Operation Kauaila[/b]
The army of Kuhaw-Astan would now be standing at almost 1 million soldiers at their disposal, thanks to the newly trained soldiers and Nordiheimian mercenaries, as well as the Argossian fighting spirit. The Kuhaw-Astan command would now give the order to execute the long-planned operation Kauaila.

During this operation, the army would split roughly in half. These two halves would be named the 1st army and the 2nd army.

The 1st army would swing up north from Kuhaw-Astan territory to capture the lauqif peninsular. This would give them access to even more coastline and push the restorationists into the east. This part of the operation would go smoothly, as the restorationists had left their mainland territories almost barren in a last-ditch attempt to save the stronghold island from the UDF. This meant that the 1st army didnt have to expend much of their expensive equipment, simply brute forcing their way north and capturing the entire peninsula within one week.

The 2nd armys objectives would be far more ambitious. Their end goal was to capture the entirety of the restorationists northern territories. This may sound like a large feat on paper, but in practice the restorationist resistance would once again be minimal. Despite this, the argossians still knew that the cost of brute strength to gain such large swathes of territory would be too high to sustain. This army would instead adopt a blitzkrieg-esque strategy, making use of their new aerial capabilities and the modern technology provided by Nordiheim.

This part of the operation would begin with a combined assault against the restorationist frontline. Nordiheimian-provided tanks and armoured vehicles would roll across the battlefield, closely supported by the entirety of kuhaw-astans limited airforce. The restorationist airforce would be distracted at the stronghold island, giving the argossians an easy time in the air. These combined convoys would speed towards key road junctions, taking control of the major transport routes and subsequently creating a backup network of supplies to fuel the operation. The army would also use these key points to surround restorationist positions and close in on them. This is when the argossians would make use of the Nordiheimian drones, which would rise out positions across the encircled area. The strategy would continue across the entire northern territory, with the restorationists outdated tactics standing no match against Nordiheimian training.

The entire operation would be complete within 2 weeks. The argossians first major operation would be a resounding success.

[b]Destroying the exclave[/b]
Whilst most troops would be diverted north from the southern frontlines to take part in operation Kauaila, a small expeditionary unit comprised of Nordiheimian mercenaries and trained argossians would remain in the south, to finally crush the restorationist exclave. Their positions only continued to fail and so the exclave would come under Argossian control within days. The Argossians had now opened up a clean frontline against the isolationists, ready for battle

Under the [b]direct[/b] command of their self-proclaimed [b]Emir, Hassan Al-Amin[/b], ISV has [i]launched a brutal campaign[/i] known as Operation [b]Nur-Al-Deen[/b], a systematic effort to "[b]purify[/b]" the Republic by targeting [u]Shia communities, foreign-born/foreign working citizens, and refugee populations[/u].

[spoiler=[b]Operation Red Falcon[/b]]
Civil war in Valddera. Yet another country that had erupted into violent conflict in 2026. The conflicts in Astanir and Tallisland were complicated messes of conflicting morals and ethnic groups, all far away from Hydronia. But Valddera was different, Valddera was right on Hydronias doorstep, and this war was a dangerous one too. The ISV, a newly established terror group was shaking Valddera and its people like they had never seen before.

Hydronia had already been carefully planning to intervene from the start, making use of the highly trained cobra team special forces. However, the blockade of Samzad and the Izibs had changed things greatly. The ISV had been foolish enough to provoke direct war from the continents greatest power and they were soon to feel the consequences.

Hydronias first response to the blockade would consist of an evacuation operation. The local authorities of Samzad and Izib would move the populations of their respective islands away from the ports and to the Center of the island to minimise civilian casualties during the naval operation that would be soon to come.

Whilst the majority of Hydronias naval forces would be elsewhere in Vespurias and stationed at the BR Bob, homeland defence was always a priority, so a task force would be kept stationed in Turqevia. This task force would now be deployed into the shamat sea to take down the ISV blockade.

In the early morning of the 12th September, ISV ships would see a Hydronian attack force on the horizon, consisting of 8 corvettes, 15 patrol boats, 3 destroyers and 2 submarines. The assault would begin almost immediately. Making use of high-power radar to see the enemy positions from afar, the Hydronians would begin firing rounds of anti-ship missiles towards the ISV blockade. The high concentration of missiles would ensure that it would be hard to intercept them all. Additionally, a swarm of cheap, yet effective drones would be released upon the blockade, using radio signals to jam the radar of the ISV. Whilst this occurred on the surface of the water, the submarines would dive beneath the surface of the water and begin firing torpedoes underneath the ISV ships, taking them out from below.

Additionally, a fleet of smaller size would be recalled from a base in the BR Bob. It would take longer for them to arrive, but once they had reached the site of the blockade, they would serve as reinforcements, bolstering Hydronian numbers and further strengthening the assault.

However, this naval attack wouldnt be the only thing that Hydronia could employ against the blockade. A squadron of jets would take to the skies from an airbase in Turqevia and begin bombarding the ISVs ships from above with more anti-ship missiles. Additionally, helicopters would also be deployed, carrying portable coastal batteries. The helicopters would land on the islands and engineer crews would begin to setup these batteries, which would be used to attack the blockade fromm the coastline, as well as to deter a landing from the ISV.

These measures would hopefully lead to the destruction of the blockade and a return to normal life on Samzad and the Izibs. If the blockade could be completely destroyed, then the task forces would remain around the islands to safeguard them from any further threats.

Whilst the blockade had prompted naval warfare from Hydronia, the real action would behind when Hydronia would launch Operation Red Falcon on the land. Much of Valdderas territory and be captured by the plague of the ISV at this point, including the two largest cities in the country, Therene and Vald. The goal of Operation Red Falcon would be to recapture Vald from the ISV, but with Vald deep within ISV territory, the army would have to begin elsewhere.

During the night of the 13th September, helicopters carrying thousands of troops would begin to pour into Valdderan airspace. They would land in various locations across the country, where soldiers would begin to construct makeshift bases of operations for Hydronia. All of these landings would take place in territory still under the control of the Valdderan government. They would first move to take transport links such as major highways and rivers, so that troops and resources could be moved around the country more effectively. If roads didnt exist, engineer units would make them. This would give Hydronia effective control over several locations across northern Valddera. For now, the troops would simply stand their ground, protecting the bases and transport routes that they had established.

A second group of helicopters would travel further south and east to establish several other landing sites, following the same strategy of landing on and capturing transport links. This would create two separate Hydronian zones within Valddera, which would be used to target different areas of ISV control.

In order to complete the transport links, Hydronian troops would have to occupy several settlements across Valddera. The Hydronian army would offer to hand these cities back over the Valdderans if they wished to cooperate, on the basis that Hydronian forces could freely use the settlements highways to transport resources, troops and equipment.

However, there would be one unit that would diverge from the plan. Cobra team, a name famous for taking down terror ground across shamat. This elite force of operatives would be flown to a location far closer to ISV territory, where they would lay dormant for now, preparing for something big

Meanwhile, on the public front, President Hakan Bozkan would make a speech condemning the actions of the ISV and proscribing them as an official terror group. He would also make the public aware that Hydronia had landed in Valddera and began operations, but did not mention the movements of cobra team, to ensure the success of their upcoming mission. Bozkan would also state that Hydronia was ready and willing to cooperate with the Valddera government, but that either way, Hydronia would maintain their position in the country until the ISV had been fully defeated. A similar statement would be made towards Arenenge, citing their cooperation through THEP and the potential to militarily cooperate further in Valddera.

[i]Hydronia has made its move, may Operation Red Falcon begin[/i]
[/spoiler]
